svg.title: V3 · Six markets, six contrasts with uncertainty
svg.desc: Forest plot with six associational contrasts in closure risk relative to the municipality. Each row distinguishes the pointwise interval, simultaneous band, and point estimate. Every simultaneous band includes zero. Their maximum ceiling is 0.273 percentage points: above the 0.25 sensitivity threshold, but below the author's 0.5 percentage-point threshold.
